thesis: A net-cash Chinese brewer with rising operating and FCF margins trades below its own 5-year minimum cash multiples, pricing shrinkage that its improving operations do not show.
reason: Scorecard conviction 4: net cash, rising operating and FCF margins and cash multiples below their 5y minimums outweigh unexplained net-margin erosion and results due within days. Python sizes it; it would breach the China/HK cap, so it replaces HKG:2076.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 12.0% (14.9% now), reversing the mix and pricing gains.
TTM FCF margin falls below 10.0% (15.3% now), showing the cash step-up was transitory.
TTM ROIC falls below 10.0% (11.9% now), below the FY2025 low of 10.4%.
Net debt/EBITDA rises above 0.0x (net cash lost).

replacement_reason: Adding this name would take China/HK combined above the 25% country cap. HKG:2076 has risen the most of the China/HK holdings since entry, while this idea trades below its own 5y minimum cash multiples with net cash and a low-beta (0.38) staples profile, a better skew from here.
